# run_records

A table. A run's membership: state = last completed step id, verdicts = {step_id: pass|fail}.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | TEXT | NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) |
| `identity_id` | TEXT | NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id) |
| `state` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `verdicts` | TEXT | NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' |

Table constraints: `PRIMARY KEY (run_id, identity_id)`.

## Definition

From `spec/ledger.sql`, which is the machine-checkable form of SPEC.md §3:

```sql
CREATE TABLE run_records (
  run_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
  state       TEXT NOT NULL,              -- last completed step id, or 'sourced'
  verdicts    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- JSON: {step_id: pass|fail}
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, identity_id)
);
```
